source.notes: arch-009 (A4 hierarchical chunks). Log-linear attention: a hierarchy of dyadic level states with per-level scales — H = Σ_level exp(segsum(g)) ∘ mask_level, o = (H ∘ qkᵀ)·v. NOT a softmax mask (H can be 0/negative); a linear-attention-like full-matrix form distinct from the canonical single-state K2 law (sweep verdict). The hierarchical construct_H_matrix/segsum/level-mask construction is the typed transform; level_scales frontend and the streaming/chunked partial-chunk state (LogLinearAttentionState) are residual.
